title: Input schema for kensho-sweep-mcp
description: kensho-sweep-mcp is a read-only MCP server. It requires no input parameters — start it and connect an MCP client (e.g. via the Apify MCP integration or Smithery) to discover its tools: current_sweep, sweep_history, top_prize_movers. All data is bundled locally; no network, no API key, no account.
